name: fmp_index_historical
description:
Daily end-of-day history of one market index from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/historical-price-eod/full as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (index symbol, e.g. ^GSPC).
For the latest level use fmp_index_quote; for symbols fmp_available_indexes.
Example: {"symbol": "^DJI"}
